title: The Last Train

cards.text: Have you ever counted passengers on the last train?
Seven of us got on. Now there are five, and the doors never opened.
Every time we enter a tunnel, the lights flicker, and another seat is empty.
The others won't look at me. They just stare at the black window.
But in the glass, all seven of our reflections are still sitting there.
Next tunnel, the woman opposite me vanished. Her coffee was still steaming.
The last man left leaned close and whispered, "Stop counting. It notices."
The lights flickered back on, and I was alone in the carriage.
The window showed all of them. Except me.
